fields.quoted_span: tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance cannot be evicted unless there is "just cause” (previously called “good cause”).
fields.note: Just cause, nonpayment threshold, lease signing, lease breach elements, Rent Board notice statement, 3-business-day filing, Notice of Tenant Rights and annual inflation adjustment are supported by D006. The posting requirement is slightly broader in D006 (interior common area). The $19,413 and $6,471 relocation amounts are not in D006; they come from D004, which is not in the supplied document.

fields.quoted_span: The landlord must file with the Rent Board a copy of any notice to terminate a tenancy, notice to quit, and summons and complaint no later than three business days after the tenant was served with the document.
fields.note: Nonpayment threshold of one month FMR, the 3-business-day filing and the 15-day notice for tenancies from Dec. 20, 2024 are supported. The $19,413 / $6,471 amounts and the 1.5% CPI adjustment are not in D006.
The rule's effective_date is empty. D006 gives no original enactment date for the just cause requirement. It says only that Measure BB passed in November 2024.

fields.quoted_span: tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance cannot be evicted unless there is "just cause”
fields.note: The document describes the requirement in the present tense as current law, consistent with in_force. Measure BB changes are presented as already in effect.

fields.quoted_span: Where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord, the unit will be exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
fields.note: D006 supports coverage of fully or partially covered units, including new construction, single-family homes, condominiums and government-subsidized units, and the shared kitchen/bath condition. The Golden Duplex, ADU, university and nonprofit cooperative exemptions are not in D006. They would come from D009, which is not in the supplied document.
D006 never cites Berkeley Mun. Code § 13.76.130 or any section number. It refers only to the 'Rent Ordinance' and 'Measure BB'. The review_note concedes the section is inferred.
